edits.text:
# Qwen3.8-27B, 4-bit AWQ W4A16 g32, BUILT LOCALLY by `hf2local quant4` (2026-10-22)
# from the BF16 Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B@1d4bf0f2 -- the ONE-CARD 27B.
# Replaced the third-party cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 on 2026-10-22
# (backup: _backups/qwen27b-awq.yaml.bak-pre-g32-20261022). The cyankiwi weights were
# DELETED from /mnt/storage/hf-cache on 2026-10-30 (owner's cleanup); a future hf2local
# 4-bit gate that wants that MTP-acceptance baseline re-downloads the public repo (20 GB).
#
# Added 2026-10-21 for one-card vLLM (llmctl PR #22): tensor_parallel_size 1, so
# `llmctl run qwen27b-awq` takes one 5090 and leaves the other serving (Strata
# `flash`, an Ollama lane, or a second vLLM preset on vllm-engine2 :8010).
#
# Same model and settings as `qwen27b` (see that preset for the parser, MTP and
# hybrid-cache notes); only the weights and the one-card sizing differ.
#   - Pack: ~/models/hf2local/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-W4A16-g32 (NVMe copy of
#     /mnt/storage/converted/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-W4A16-g32-calibB), 19.56 GiB,
#     compressed-tensors pack-quantized, group 32, vision tower and MTP kept.
#   - Gates (docs/ADR-2026-10-21-hf2local-calibrated-4bit.md): KL vs the hf2local
#     FP8 pack 0.0266 / 0.0295 (cyankiwi 0.0252 / 0.0290), MTP acceptance PASS,
#     157 vs 140 tok/s on one card.
#   - KV at TP=1 is ~32 KB/token at fp8 (16 of 64 layers hold KV); the cyankiwi
#     pack measured a 139,179-token pool at util 0.90 (2026-10-21).
#   - QUALITY UNMEASURED vs the evaluated FP8 tutor (no rigor ruler or tutor smoke):
#     a second model, not a tutor replacement, until it passes the gate.

alias: qwen27b-awq
served_name: qwen3.8-27b-awq

edits.text:
# Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored (orcarouter abliterated requant of the vendor block-FP8).
#
# SIBLING of qwen3.8-27b.yaml, NOT a replacement. The deployed tutor generator
# stays `qwen3.8-27b`; this preset exists so an uncensored variant can be swapped
# in on demand. Because there is ONE vllm-tp unit, activating this EVICTS the
# tutor generator until you swap back — that is the whole cost of using it.
#
# Provenance: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8, an "abliterated" (refusal-
# direction ablated) derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, requantized to block-FP8.
# Same qwen3_5 hybrid architecture (48 Gated-DeltaNet linear_attn + 16 full-
# attention layers) and same vision tower, so every engine setting below is
# copied verbatim from the vendor preset. 7 shards, ~30.9 GB (~15.5 GB/card).
#
# MTP speculative decoding: ENABLED, k=3. This preset previously carried a "NO
# spec_config" note claiming THIS repo ships no MTP weights, and that the vendor
# head is trained against un-ablated hidden states so borrowing it is unsound.
# BOTH halves were wrong, and no graft is needed. Corrected 2026-09-09 to match
# services/vllm-tp.env.qwen38-unc, which adopted MTP on 2026-08-26; the preset
# had stayed stale, and llmctl regenerating vllm-tp.env from it silently dropped
# VLLM_SPEC_CONFIG from the live env.
#
# The repo ships no FILE named mtp.safetensors, but it ships the HEAD: all 22
# mtp.* tensors are physically present in model-00007-of-00007.safetensors and
# listed in model.safetensors.index.json, at the same shapes and dtypes as the
# vendor's standalone mtp.safetensors. Transferability never came into it —
# the abliteration carried its own head.
#
# Measured on 2x5090, 1000-token completion, same prompt as the vendor A/B:
#                        tok/s   acceptance   per-position          per pass
#   unc, no spec config   61.4   --           --                    1 of 1
#   unc, mtp k=3          86.0   0.584        78.5 / 56.7 / 39.9%   2.75 of 4
#   vendor qwen38, k=3   100.4   0.535        76.8 / 51.6 / 32.0%   2.60 of 4
#
# +40%, and acceptance is HIGHER than the un-ablated vendor model's. Costs match
# the vendor profile: boot ~225s (not ~70s) and a smaller KV pool at GPU_MEM 0.80.
# NOTE vLLM disables min_p and logit_bias under speculative decoding.
# AUDITED 2026-09-09: no consumer of :8003 sets either. Checked (a) code under
# ~/AI, ~/.hermes, ~/Projects, ~/.claude/skills across py/js/ts/json/yaml/toml/sh
# -- zero hits outside the vendored llama.cpp tree, which is a different backend;
# (b) the gateways -- llm-router/litellm/config.yaml, llm-router/config/router.yaml
# and the whole ~/AI/llm-router tree; (c) ~/.hermes/config.yaml; (d) the Open WebUI
# sqlite DB (harbor.webui, read-only, every table) -- only the `file` table matched,
# i.e. the strings sit inside uploaded RAG document text, NOT in sampling config;
# the model/config/user tables that hold per-model and per-user sampling params are
# clean. This re-confirms the vendor preset's rag-webui-shim / rag check.
# RESIDUAL GAP: an Open WebUI user can still type min_p into per-chat advanced
# params at request time. That is a live ad-hoc override, not a persisted config,
# so it would not show in the DB. Re-run the audit before assuming it still holds.
#
# Re-confirmed live 2026-09-09, after the preset/env drift noted above was
# fixed and vllm-tp restarted with the flag actually present:
#   99.1 tok/s, acceptance 0.611, per-position 78.8 / 61.2 / 43.3%, 2.83 of 4.
# (Acceptance read from the /metrics spec_decode counters: 353 drafts, 1059
# draft tokens, 647 accepted.) NOT a like-for-like row in the table above --
# different prompt, temperature 0, reasoning_effort low -- so it is recorded
# separately rather than replacing the 86.0 figure.
# Boot was 105s, not ~225s, because the torch.compile cache was already warm;
# expect ~225s on a cold cache. Engine confirms MTP at boot with
# "Detected MTP model. Sharing target model embedding weights with the draft
# model." on both TP ranks; KV pool 435,104 tokens, 3.32x concurrency at
# 131,072 -- matching the vendor MTP profile (433,753 / 3.31x).
#
# gpu_memory_utilization 0.80, same as the vendor preset: ollama sits resident
# and ASYMMETRIC (~3.5 GB on GPU1 vs ~0.5 GB on GPU0), and 0.85 OOM-crashed the
# vendor config on real retrieval-length prompts on 2026-08-18. With MTP now on,
# headroom matches the vendor profile — do not raise it without re-validating
# against real long prompts and watching free VRAM on GPU 1.
#
# Quality is UNMEASURED. Abliteration is known to cost general capability, and
# nothing in this stack has evaluated this checkpoint. Do NOT point the math
# shims (RAG_SHIM_GEN_MODEL) or routing.default_backend at it.

edits.name: live-qwen27b.yaml:identity
edits.text:
# Qwen3.8-27B (vendor block-FP8) — dense hybrid-Mamba, NATIVE VISION-LANGUAGE.
#
# Same qwen3_5 architecture family as the deployed qwen3.6-27b tutor generator
# (48 Gated-DeltaNet linear_attn + 16 full-attention layers, 3:1 interleave), so
# the parser/cache settings below are copied from that preset deliberately.
# What changed in 3.8: image + video input is live (language_model_only=false,
# vision tower + mrope_interleaved), and the checkpoint ships MTP weights.
#
# QUANT CHOICE — vendor FP8, not BF16 / NVFP4 / GGUF:
#   - BF16 is ~55.6 GB of weights = 27.8 GB/card at TP=2. That leaves no room
#     for the Gated-DeltaNet recurrent state (~75 MB/card PER SEQUENCE) plus KV
#     plus activations inside 32 GB. Not servable here.
#   - Vendor FP8 is block-scaled (weight_block_size [128,128], e4m3, dynamic
#     activations) = ~31 GB total, ~15.5 GB/card. Block-scaled FP8 selects the
#     DeepGemm block kernel and never enters the buggy cutlass scaled_mm path
#     (see docs/RUNBOOK.md, "cutlass scaled_mm FP8 bug") — this is why it loads on vLLM >= 0.22.
#   - NVFP4 (~16 GB, would fit ONE card) exists only as day-old third-party
#     requants, and the 2026-06 NVFP4-vs-AWQ A/B on llama-3.3-70b came out
#     against NVFP4. Not worth the quality risk for a 27B dense model.
#   - GGUF is NOT an option: the vendored llama.cpp (build 10285, 2026-08-05)
#     knows `qwen3next` but has no qwen3.5/qwen3_5 arch, and ollama 0.23.2 the
#     same. Both predate this model by days.
#
# python_root = vllm-laguna, NOT the usual vllm-serve env. On 2026-08-13 04:03
# something reinstalled vLLM into vllm-serve as a CPU wheel (vllm-0.26.0+cpu)
# alongside torch 2.11.0+cu129, and that env can no longer even `import torch`
# (libtorch_cuda.so: undefined symbol ncclWaitSignal — nccl_cu12 and nccl_cu13
# 2.28.9 both installed). The live vllm-tp survives only because it started
# 2026-08-08, before the change. vllm-laguna (0.25.1+cu129) is healthy, imports
# fine, registers Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (multimodal, IsHybrid) and
# Qwen3_5MTP, and ships transformers 5.14.1. Point this preset back at
# vllm-serve once that env is repaired.
#
#   - tool_parser qwen3_xml, NOT hermes/qwen3_coder: the 3.8 chat template
#     mandates <tool_call><function=name><parameter=k> XML, same as 3.6.
#   - reasoning_parser qwen3: the template emits the OPENING <think> in the
#     prompt, so generation carries only the closing tag.
#   - max_num_batched_tokens 8192: hybrid-Mamba cache block_size must be
#     <= --max-num-batched-tokens, and chunked prefill would default it to 2048

# Qwen3.8-27B (vendor block-FP8) — dense hybrid-Mamba, NATIVE VISION-LANGUAGE.
#
# Same qwen3_5 architecture family as the deployed qwen3.6-27b tutor generator
# (48 Gated-DeltaNet linear_attn + 16 full-attention layers, 3:1 interleave), so
# the parser/cache settings below are copied from that preset deliberately.
# What changed in 3.8: image + video input is live (language_model_only=false,
# vision tower + mrope_interleaved), and the checkpoint ships MTP weights.
#
# QUANT CHOICE — vendor FP8, not BF16 / NVFP4 / GGUF:
#   - BF16 is ~55.6 GB of weights = 27.8 GB/card at TP=2. That leaves no room
#     for the Gated-DeltaNet recurrent state (~75 MB/card PER SEQUENCE) plus KV
#     plus activations inside 32 GB. Not servable here.
#   - Vendor FP8 is block-scaled (weight_block_size [128,128], e4m3, dynamic
#     activations) = ~31 GB total, ~15.5 GB/card. Block-scaled FP8 selects the
#     DeepGemm block kernel and never enters the buggy cutlass scaled_mm path
#     (see docs/RUNBOOK.md, "cutlass scaled_mm FP8 bug") — this is why it loads on vLLM >= 0.22.
#   - NVFP4 (~16 GB, would fit ONE card) exists only as day-old third-party
#     requants, and the 2026-06 NVFP4-vs-AWQ A/B on llama-3.3-70b came out
#     against NVFP4. Not worth the quality risk for a 27B dense model.
#   - GGUF is NOT an option: the vendored llama.cpp (build 10285, 2026-08-05)
#     knows `qwen3next` but has no qwen3.5/qwen3_5 arch, and ollama 0.23.2 the
#     same. Both predate this model by days.
#
# python_root = vllm-laguna, NOT the usual vllm-serve env. On 2026-08-13 04:03
# something reinstalled vLLM into vllm-serve as a CPU wheel (vllm-0.26.0+cpu)
# alongside torch 2.11.0+cu129, and that env can no longer even `import torch`
# (libtorch_cuda.so: undefined symbol ncclWaitSignal — nccl_cu12 and nccl_cu13
# 2.28.9 both installed). The live vllm-tp survives only because it started
# 2026-08-08, before the change. vllm-laguna (0.25.1+cu129) is healthy, imports
# fine, registers Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (multimodal, IsHybrid) and
# Qwen3_5MTP, and ships transformers 5.14.1. Point this preset back at
# vllm-serve once that env is repaired.
#
#   - tool_parser qwen3_xml, NOT hermes/qwen3_coder: the 3.8 chat template
#     mandates <tool_call><function=name><parameter=k> XML, same as 3.6.
#   - reasoning_parser qwen3: the template emits the OPENING <think> in the
#     prompt, so generation carries only the closing tag.
#   - max_num_batched_tokens 8192: hybrid-Mamba cache block_size must be
#     <= --max-num-batched-tokens, and chunked prefill would default it to 2048
#     and assert during engine-core init.
#   - max_model_len 262144 = native (raised from 131072 on 2026-09-18 to match
#     the live vllm-tp.env / vllm-tp.env.qwen38, which had served 262144 for a
#     while). KV math: only 16 of 64 layers hold KV (16 KB/token/card at fp8),
#     so ~7 GB of KV pool is ~450K tokens. 1M context needs YaRN factor 4.0 via
#     --hf-overrides; do not enable it for short-context work.
#   - spec_config: MTP speculative decoding, MEASURED and ADOPTED 2026-08-17.
#     mtp.safetensors ships in the repo (477 MB FP8, 1 layer vs the model's 64)
#     and both vLLM envs register Qwen3_5MTP. A/B via scripts/bench-vllm.py at
#     512-token completions, everything else held fixed:
#         concurrency    off      k=2      k=3
#           n=1         60.7     94.9    112.0   <- 1.84x, interactive tutor
#           n=4        213.1    244.5    275.9   <- 1.29x, eval collect
#           n=8        345.0    392.9    368.7   <- the only k=2 win
#     k=3 acceptance by position 76.0/55.4/39.5% = 2.71 tokens per forward pass
#     out of 4; on live tutor traffic it runs better still (~3.0/4, 302.8 tok/s
#     aggregate at 4-way). k=2 wins only at n=8, where a saturated GPU spends
#     real compute on rejected drafts — neither of our workloads runs there.
#     Costs: KV pool 618,951 -> 514,829 tokens (still 3.93x concurrency at the
#     full 131,072, against ~2.6% live usage) and boot ~225s instead of ~70s.
#     Use "mtp"; 0.25.1 accepts "qwen3_5_mtp" but logs it deprecated.
#     NOTE vLLM disables min_p and logit_bias under speculative decoding —
#     verified neither appears in rag-webui-shim or rag before adopting.
#
# Thinking is ON by default; per-request control is reasoning_effort
# (xhigh|medium|low, default xhigh) and preserve_thinking, both passed through
# chat_template_kwargs.
